summary: Run open models on your own machine, so GemAir can think offline.

steps.title: Install Ollama
steps.body: winget fetches the signed installer from Ollama and runs it silently. Nothing here needs an account.

steps.title: Check Ollama answers
steps.body: If this prints a version, the service is installed and on PATH.

steps.title: Download a small model
steps.body: llama3.2:3b is about 2 GB and runs on a laptop without a discrete GPU. This is the slow step — it downloads once and is yours afterwards.

steps.title: Say hello to it
steps.body: A one-line answer from the model proves the whole path works: service running, model on disk, GPU or CPU picked.
steps.command: ollama run llama3.2:3b "reply with the single word: ready"
